name: Rema Schneider
summary: In Stormwind City, Rema Schneider works from the Canal Tailor and Fit Shop. She is a human citizen who often helps local shopkeepers and artisans with trade deliveries.

sections.title: Shopkeeper of the Canals
sections.body: Rema Schneider manages daily trade from the Canal Tailor and Fit Shop. The shop stands just west of the stone bridge into Cathedral Square, along Stormwind's canals. Cloth and finished garments move between local craftsmen, and Rema relies on helpful couriers to carry supplies between workshops.

faq.answer: Rema Schneider works inside the Canal Tailor and Fit Shop in Stormwind City. It sits along the Canals, just west of the bridge into Cathedral Square.

faq.q: What role does Rema play in Stormwind?
faq.answer: Rema coordinates local trade errands, supply packages, and resupply orders between merchants and craftspeople across the city.
No. Rema works from the Canal Tailor and Fit Shop and handles shipments of tailor goods, but she is neither a profession trainer nor a primary vendor.

angles.text: Rema works inside the Canal Tailor and Fit Shop, an everyday part of Stormwind's clothworking trade.
As a traveler or new recruit in Stormwind, you may run simple courier tasks for Rema while getting your bearings in the capital.
